title: Welcome polish: notice projects added elsewhere, tilde paths, status line and wording

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S96 relay later notes. (1) The TUI does not notice projects added via the CLI or the daemon while it runs: Welcome stays up, and a TUI add of the same name hits the duplicate refusal. (2) No tilde expansion in the Welcome path field; relative paths are refused by the daemon (shown verbatim). (3) The status line with zero projects reads 'refreshed never | pending 0'. (4) Casing: the success status 'added NAME PATH' is lower case while Welcome statuses are capitalised. (5) Welcome error and cancel messages show in the bottom detail area, far from the field. (6) The guide says 'add them' for a single PATH; 'add one' reads better (the spec pinned the wording; owner word needed).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/welcome.go`, `welcome_test.go`: tilde expansion; messages next to the field; casing.
- `internal/tui/model.go` and `internal/tui/view.go`: leave Welcome when the snapshot gains a project; status line text with no projects.
- `internal/cli/*.go`: the guide wording (owner decides "add them" or "add one").
- `testdata/golden/welcome-*.txt`, `docs/dashboard.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestWelcomeLeavesWhenAProjectAppearsElsewhere.
- TestWelcomePathExpandsTilde.
- TestStatusLineWithNoProjectsHasNoRefreshedNever.
- TestWelcomeMessagesSitNextToTheField.
- TestGuideSaysAddOne (once the owner confirms the wording).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Tests first. 2. Fix each item in Why. 3. Update goldens (go test ./internal/tui -update) and docs. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Open for the owner: the guide wording (add them vs add one).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui ./internal/cli
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
